title: Terra AI Model Pricing Changes by OpenAI
description: OpenAI has announced price reductions for its Terra and Luna AI models, as reported by various news outlets.

sources.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6

sections.heading: Price-Performance Advancements
paragraphs: OpenAI has made advancements in the price-performance frontier with its GPT-5.6 models, according to OpenAI.

sections.heading: Pricing Sensitivity
paragraphs: CNBC reports that companies are becoming increasingly sensitive to costs, prompting OpenAI to cut prices for two of its GPT-5.6 AI models.

sections.heading: Price Reductions
paragraphs: Axios has reported that OpenAI has slashed the pricing for its Luna AI model.

faq.a: Terra is one of OpenAI's GPT-5.6 AI models.
According to CNBC, the reduction is due to companies becoming more sensitive to costs.
